scripts.title: Anti Riot Shield Open Source
scripts.script:
while true do
    for _, v in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if v.Name == "RiotShieldPart" then
            v:Destroy()
        end
    end
    task.wait(2)
end

local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.5) do
        local char = player.Character
        if char then
            local shield = char:FindFirstChild("RiotShieldPart")

            if not shield then
                local part = Instance.new("Part")
                part.Name = "RiotShieldPart"
                part.Size = Vector3.new(4,6,1)
                part.CanCollide = true
                part.Anchored = false
                part.Parent = char

                local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
                weld.Part0 = part
                weld.Part1 = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                weld.Parent = part
            end
        end
    end
end)

scripts.title: Lumonisty Aimbot ESP and UI Visuals
scripts.features:
Lumonisty is a versatile tool designed to give you better control and awareness while playing. It features a smart targeting system that helps you stay locked onto opponents, including a special setting that can identify when an enemy is looking right at you. You can easily adjust the size of your targeting area and the speed of the lock on to match your own playstyle. It also includes a team check so you don't accidentally target your friends.
In addition to the combat help, the script provides a lot of useful visual information. You can use the ESP feature to see where other players and weapons are located through walls, or use the FreeCam mode to scout the map from any angle. The interface is very organized and easy to understand and control, allowing you to change colors and customize the look of your crosshair. It even shows you helpful server details like how long the game has been running and which region you are playing in, making it a complete package for improving your gameplay.
